step.label: Register and validate customer production order
step.description: Capture new customer orders and verify account eligibility and order specifications for manufacturing fulfillment.
step.useCase: Customer places a manufacturing order that must be registered in the system and validated for business rules compliance before proceeding to production planning.

step.label: Verify material bill-of-materials compliance
step.description: Validate that all materials specified in the production bill-of-materials meet engineering and regulatory compliance standards.
step.useCase: Production engineering requires verification that selected materials and product components comply with engineering change notices and material specifications before manufacturing begins.

step.label: Coordinate product specification changes with sales
step.description: Notify and coordinate with sales team regarding any engineering changes or material substitutions that impact customer delivery or contract terms.
step.useCase: When engineering changes or material changes are identified, sales must be informed to manage customer expectations and contractual obligations.

step.label: Receive and process vendor material invoices
step.description: Ingest vendor invoices for raw materials and components required to fulfill the production order.
step.useCase: Vendors submit invoices for materials procured; these must be received, validated, and matched to purchase orders for accurate cost tracking and inventory updates.

step.label: Analyze material cost and compliance metrics
step.description: Evaluate invoice compliance, material costs, and cost variances against budgeted manufacturing costs and compliance thresholds.
step.useCase: Finance and procurement teams need visibility into material cost trends and compliance issues to optimize supplier performance and control manufacturing costs.

step.label: Schedule production orders and assign manufacturing equipment
step.description: Create and schedule production orders on available manufacturing machines based on material availability, machine capacity, and delivery deadlines.
step.useCase: Production planners must allocate customer orders to available machines and create detailed production schedules that optimize equipment utilization and meet delivery dates.

step.label: Assign workforce and review compensation impact
step.description: Allocate production workers to scheduled production orders and assess labor cost and compensation implications of the production schedule.
step.useCase: Production requires human labor allocation; HR and operations must confirm workforce availability, skill matching, and review overtime or shift implications on compensation.

step.label: Review workforce compensation trends and finalize labor plan
step.description: Analyze compensation trends for assigned workforce to ensure labor cost forecasting accuracy and alignment with operational budget before production authorization.
step.useCase: HR analytics require visibility into compensation costs and trends to validate that the proposed labor allocation does not create unexpected payroll impacts and remains within workforce budget.
